property_summary: For any call to fallback that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly later block timestamp than the previous call, the reference contract C only forwards the entire contract balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant that unconditionally transfers will sometimes drain the contract when block.number % 15 != 0, violating the rule that address(c).balance remains > 0 after such calls at non-drain blocks.
change_summary: Always transfer funds to the caller (remove the block.number % 15 condition), which changes whether balance is drained and thus can affect subsequent observable state.
